Blocked Street: Requests about physical obstructions in streets, alleys, or sidewalks caused by vehicles, vegetation, or debris that block passage or access, including blocked trash receptacles and right-of-way issues. | NOT: Overgrown vegetation that only causes visibility issues (see Line of Sight), or general overgrowth not specifically blocking passage (see Excessive Growth).

Excessive Growth: Requests about overgrown vegetation, junk, trashy yards, brush piles, and general property neglect, including junk cars and trash piles, even if the wording mentions blocking or encroachment, unless the main issue is passage or visibility. | NOT: Vegetation specifically blocking passage (see Blocked Street) or obstructing visibility at intersections/signs (see Line of Sight).

Line of Sight: Requests about vegetation or objects obstructing visibility at intersections, driveways, or traffic signs, even if the wording mentions overgrowth or blocking, as long as the main issue is visibility for drivers or pedestrians. | NOT: General overgrowth or blocked passage (see Excessive Growth and Blocked Street).

Parking on Unimproved Surface: Requests about vehicles parked on lawns, grass, or other non-paved surfaces, including shared drives and unplated/inoperable vehicles parked in grass. | NOT: Junk cars as part of general property neglect (see Excessive Growth).

Parks & Playgrounds: Requests about parks, playgrounds, recreational facilities, or related programming, including complaints about spending or sign-ups for classes. | NOT: Issues about signage or trash in parks (see Temporary Signage w/o permit or Trash).

Recycling: Requests about improper sorting, contamination, or handling of recyclable materials, including missed recycling pickups and non-recyclables in recycling bins. | NOT: General trash issues or missed trash pickup (see Trash).

Sewer Problems (Sanitary Sewers): Requests about sanitary sewer issues, including overflows, odors, manhole problems, and sewer backups. | NOT: Stormwater or drainage issues (see Sidewalk Snow Removal).

Sidewalk & Curb Complaints: Requests about physical damage or hazards to sidewalks and curbs, such as broken sidewalks or fallen retaining walls. | NOT: Sidewalks blocked by vegetation or snow (see Blocked Street or Street Snow Removal).

Sidewalk Snow Removal: Requests about clogged storm inlets, drainage, culverts, storm sewer drains, and water flow issues related to sidewalks, even if not directly about snow. | NOT: Snow or ice removal from streets or general snow complaints (see Street Snow Removal).

Street Snow Removal: Requests about snow and ice removal from streets and sidewalks, including complaints about plowing, shoveling, and snow piles from parking lots. | NOT: Drainage or stormwater issues (see Sidewalk Snow Removal).

Temporary Signage w/o permit: Requests about temporary, flashing, moving, or unpermitted signs, including balloons, scrolling message boards, and event signage. | NOT: Permanent signage or signs causing visibility issues (see Line of Sight).

Traffic Related Complaints: Requests about traffic flow, speed, signage placement, street lighting, and intersection studies, including complaints about traffic signs creating line of sight issues. | NOT: Physical obstructions or visibility blocked by vegetation (see Blocked Street or Line of Sight).

Trash: Requests about trash collection, missed pickups, can size limits, stickers, dumpsters, and trash left on property, including some recycling-related missed pickups. | NOT: Yard waste or recycling sorting issues (see Yard Waste or Recycling).

Unsafe Buildings: Requests about structurally unsafe buildings, walls, cisterns, or trailers, including concerns about children’s safety and vacant properties. | NOT: General property neglect or trashy yards (see Excessive Growth).

Water Quality: Requests about water taste, odor, leaks, water shut-offs, main breaks, and after-hours water service. | NOT: Water billing issues (see Water Utility Billing Problems).

Water Utility Billing Problems: Requests about water billing errors, high bills, fee disputes, and requests for bill reviews or adjustments. | NOT: Water quality or leak issues (see Water Quality or Water Utility Problems).

Water Utility Problems: Requests about water leaks, standing water, malfunctioning sprinklers, meter issues, and water bubbling up, including suspected leaks due to high bills. | NOT: Water quality complaints (see Water Quality) or billing disputes (see Water Utility Billing Problems).

Yard Waste: Requests about yard waste collection, including requirements for stickers, plastic bags, and courtesy pickups. | NOT: General trash, recycling, or overgrown vegetation (see Trash, Recycling, or Excessive Growth).
